func TestStoreFetchSeesExternalRetag(t *testing.T) {
 dir, repo := testRepository(t, layer(\"default\", "'`flags:'"\\n  - key: old\\n    name: Old\\n    enabled: true"'`, MediaTypeFliptNamespace+"+yaml"))
 store, err := NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: "flipt://local/"+repo+":latest"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 ctx := context.Background()
 first, err := store.Fetch(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 for _, f := range first.Files { require.NoError(t, f.Close()) }
 writer, err := oci.New(path.Join(dir, repo))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 desc, err := oras.PackManifest(ctx, writer, oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4, MediaTypeFliptFeatures, oras.PackManifestOptions{Layers: []v1.Descriptor{layer("other", `flags:'"\\n  - key: new\\n    name: New\\n    enabled: true"'`, MediaTypeFliptNamespace+"+yaml")(t, writer)}})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, writer.Tag(ctx, desc, "latest"))
 second, err := store.Fetch(ctx, IfNoMatch(first.Digest))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.False(t, second.Matched)
 assert.NotEqual(t, first.Digest, second.Digest)
 for _, f := range second.Files { require.NoError(t, f.Close()) }
}
EOF

func TestSourceGetAndSubscribeCancellation(t *testing.T) {
 store, err := fliptoci.NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: t.TempDir(), Repository: \"flipt://local/test:latest\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 source, err := NewSource(zaptest.NewLogger(t), store, WithPollInterval(time.Millisecond))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, \"oci\", source.String())
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 cancel()
 ch := make(chan *storagefs.StoreSnapshot)
 source.Subscribe(ctx, ch)
 _, ok := <-ch
 require.False(t, ok)
}
EOF
cat >> .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'

Root cause evidence: ORAS OCI Store loads index/tag resolver in "'`oci.New`, so an existing `Store.store` holds stale tags after an external process changes index.json. `Store.Fetch` copies from that old instance. `SnapshotSource.Get` has no context. Existing decoder rejects features media type and ignores namespace annotation. Hypothesis: reopening the local OCI store per fetch and passing the chosen target to the decoder will expose external retags; a source can cache by digest.
EOF

/bin/bash -lc "cat >> internal/storage/fs/oci/source_test.go <<'EOF'

func TestSourceLocalUpdates(t *testing.T) {
 dir := t.TempDir()
 ctx := context.Background()
 writeBundle := func(key string) {
  t.Helper()
  writer, err := orasoci.New(filepath.Join(dir, \"repo\"))
  require.NoError(t, err)
  payload := []byte(\"flags:\\n  - key: \" + key + \"\\n    name: \" + key + \"\\n    enabled: true\\n\")
  layer := v1.Descriptor{
   MediaType: fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures + \"+yaml\",
   Digest: digest.FromBytes(payload), Size: int64(len(payload)),
   Annotations: map[string]string{fliptoci.AnnotationFliptNamespace: \"team\"},
  }
  require.NoError(t, writer.Push(ctx, layer, bytes.NewReader(payload)))
  manifest, err := oras.PackManifest(ctx, writer, oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4, fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures, oras.PackManifestOptions{Layers: []v1.Descriptor{layer}})
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, writer.Tag(ctx, manifest, \"latest\"))
 }
 writeBundle(\"first\")
 store, err := fliptoci.NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: \"flipt://local/repo:latest\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 source, err := NewSource(zaptest.NewLogger(t), store, WithPollInterval(5*time.Millisecond))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 first, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 flag, err := first.GetFlag(ctx, \"team\", \"first\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, \"first\", flag.Key)
 same, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Same(t, first, same)

 pollCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
 ch := make(chan *storagefs.StoreSnapshot)
 done := make(chan struct{})
 go func() { source.Subscribe(pollCtx, ch); close(done) }()
 select {
 case <-ch: t.Fatal(\"subscription sent unchanged snapshot\")
 case <-time.After(30*time.Millisecond):
 }
 writeBundle(\"second\")
 select {
 case next := <-ch:
  require.NotSame(t, first, next)
  _, err := next.GetFlag(ctx, \"team\", \"second\")
  require.NoError(t, err)
 case <-time.After(time.Second): t.Fatal(\"subscription did not observe external retag\")
 }
 cancel()
 select {
 case <-done:
 case <-time.After(time.Second): t.Fatal(\"subscription did not stop\")
 }
}
EOF

func TestStoreFetchGzipLayer(t *testing.T) {
 content := []byte(\"namespace: team\\n\")
 var compressed bytes.Buffer
 zw := gzip.NewWriter(&compressed)
 _, err := zw.Write(content)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, zw.Close())
 dir, repo := testRepository(t, func(t *testing.T, store oras.Target) v1.Descriptor {
  payload := compressed.Bytes()
  desc := v1.Descriptor{MediaType: MediaTypeFliptNamespace + \"+yaml+gzip\", Digest: digest.FromBytes(payload), Size: int64(len(payload))}
  require.NoError(t, store.Push(context.Background(), desc, bytes.NewReader(payload)))
  return desc
 })
 source, err := NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: \"flipt://local/\" + repo + \":latest\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 result, err := source.Fetch(context.Background())
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Len(t, result.Files, 1)
 defer result.Files[0].Close()
 stat, err := result.Files[0].Stat()
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, \".yaml\", path.Ext(stat.Name()))
 got, err := io.ReadAll(result.Files[0])
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, content, got)
}
EOF
